text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board ratification on the negotiated terms of the collective agreement with IATSE Local B-173 representing Housekeeping at the Meridian Arts Centre.

The TO Live - Human Resources and Stakeholder Relations Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the negotiated terms of the collective agreement with IATSE Local B-173, as outlined in Confidential Attachment 1. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 remain confidential in its entirety, s it is about labour relations and employee negotiations.
